redfin.remarks: Beautifully updated 3-bedroom, 2.5-bath view home offering approximately 1,878 sq ft of thoughtfully upgraded living space on a quiet street in a highly desirable Woodland Hills neighborhood. This light-filled residence features engineered hardwood floors , custom millwork , recessed lighting , dual-pane windows , and an open-concept floorplan designed for modern California living. The spacious living room with decorative fireplace flows into the formal dining area filled with natural light. The remodeled chef’s kitchen showcases custom cabinetry, quartz countertops, designer tile backsplash, brass hardware, and stainless-steel appliances, opening seamlessly to the family room and private balcony with scenic hillside views. The primary suite offers a peaceful retreat with beautiful views, balcony access, walk-in closet space, and a spa-inspired bathroom with custom vanity and oversized walk-in shower. Secondary bedrooms are well-sized and adjacent to a beautifully updated hall bath with designer finishes and soaking tub. The entertainer’s backyard features a sparkling pool, expansive new concrete hardscape, built-in BBQ with bar seating and refrigerator, low-voltage landscape lighting, rolling lawn, and multiple sitting areas ideal for gatherings. Additional upgrades include a newer upgraded 3-layer roof system, owned solar system with 22 panels, fully replaced sewer line from the house to the street, Ring security system with exterior cameras, automatic drip and sprinkler irrigation systems, new perimeter fencing, and a finished, insulated garage with Tesla charging outlet creating flexible bonus space. Conveniently located near The Village, Westfield Topanga, Calabasas Commons, parks, golf, dining, and award-winning schools.
